column1: # Dual-OTA partition table for ip4knx on 4 MB ESP32-C3 / ESP32-C6 flash.
# Both app slots are 1.9375 MB to leave headroom (current firmware ~1.21 MB).
# NVS stays at 0x9000 size 0x5000 to preserve WiFi credentials + KNX EEPROM
# across migrations from the older layouts.
# Project does not use SPIFFS/LittleFS — KNX stack persists via EEPROM.h
